# Larnel J Hight
> Personal site of Larnel J Hight covering AI governance, security leadership, enterprise architecture, and advisory work.

The site presents Larnel J Hight’s perspective on building governance structures that make innovation safe at enterprise scale, along with current initiatives and writing on AI risk, security, and enterprise adoption.

## Main
- [Home](https://larnelhight.com/): Overview of Larnel J Hight’s AI governance, security leadership, and current work.
- [About](https://larnelhight.com/about): Background, experience, and leadership perspective across security, architecture, and governance.
- [Contact](https://larnelhight.com/contact): Ways to connect regarding advisory, speaking, or collaboration opportunities.

## Core Perspectives
- [Three Eras. One Thread.](https://larnelhight.com/#three-eras-one-thread): Career narrative connecting security leadership, enterprise architecture, and AI governance.
- [How I Think About the Work](https://larnelhight.com/#how-i-think-about-the-work): Framework for approaching governance, innovation, and enterprise-scale risk management.
- [People, Process, Technology](https://larnelhight.com/#people-process-technology): Operating model emphasizing organizational, procedural, and technical alignment.
- [AI Risk Evaluation Model](https://larnelhight.com/#ai-risk-evaluation-model): Structured approach for assessing AI risk in enterprise environments.
- [Secure-by-Architecture](https://larnelhight.com/#secure-by-architecture): Design philosophy for embedding security and governance into systems early.
- [Governance-First Adoption](https://larnelhight.com/#governance-first-adoption): Approach to enabling AI adoption through governance-led decision making.

## Current Work
- [What I Am Building Right Now](https://larnelhight.com/#what-i-am-building-right-now): Summary of active initiatives and areas of focus.
- [Enterprise AI Governance](https://larnelhight.com/#enterprise-ai-governance): Work focused on governance structures for responsible enterprise AI deployment.
- [Render Defense](https://larnelhight.com/#render-defense): Initiative related to security, defense, or protective architecture.
- [Adversarial ML Research](https://larnelhight.com/#adversarial-ml-research): Research focus on adversarial machine learning risks and defenses.
- [Technology Risk Advisory](https://larnelhight.com/#technology-risk-advisory): Advisory work on technology risk, governance, and enterprise decision support.

## Writing
- [What Is on My Mind](https://larnelhight.com/#what-is-on-my-mind): Entry point to essays and commentary on AI governance and risk.
- [Why AI Governance Cannot Be an Afterthought](https://larnelhight.com/why-ai-governance-cannot-be-an-afterthought): Article on integrating governance early in AI programs.
- [Risk-Informed Decision Making for AI Deployment](https://larnelhight.com/risk-informed-decision-making-for-ai-deployment): Article on balancing innovation with structured AI risk decisions.

## Topics
- [AI Governance](https://larnelhight.com/#enterprise-ai-governance): Governance models, controls, and operating structures for enterprise AI.
- [Security Leadership](https://larnelhight.com/#three-eras-one-thread): Leadership perspective shaped by 25 years in security and enterprise architecture.
- [Enterprise Architecture](https://larnelhight.com/#secure-by-architecture): Architectural approach for secure, scalable, and governable systems.
- [Technology Risk](https://larnelhight.com/#technology-risk-advisory): Risk management methods for emerging technology and AI adoption.
- [Adversarial Machine Learning](https://larnelhight.com/#adversarial-ml-research): Research and analysis of adversarial threats in ML systems.
